### 1. User expression and simulator role
Joanna Gerrity (subscriber and patient) believes Cascade overpaid her braces because her banding preceded the end of the adult waiting period; wants "to find out what you owe back and to pay it back today". No amount suggested. Passive persona: identity (5095550118, DOB 1983-06-30, ZIP 98902, CM72077416), case OC-72-56930, "never had any" prior ortho coverage, "Cascade dental ... since July 2022", payments: start-up March, June, September. "You are happy for the agent to do whatever has to be done on Cascade's side"; she runs the repayment step herself with the values given.

### 2. Act now / wait / refuse
Act now: agent re-establishes the case as a takeover, then the member repays. Grounds:
- Rider `e68afc61-...` `Cascade Ortho Rider Family 1500`, active, enrollee Joanna 1983-06-30, effective 2025-01-01, prior_ortho_coverage_months 0; the only rider in the world.
- Dental PPO enrollment `2e501cd9-...` Premier 2000, individual, coverage_effective_date 2022-07-01.
- Case: establishment `bf108f98-...` new_start, out_of_network, fixed_braces, banding 2026-03-12, 26 months, total 5600.00, allowed 5200.00, 2026-03-20; transfer `2ee629c0-...` 2026-09-25, agreement `1d597c16-...` in_network, 25 months, remaining 19, total 3100.00, allowed 3088.80.
- Payments: initial 375.00 (`efd3aa2e-...`, 2026-03, member), inst 1 140.63 (2026-06), inst 2 140.63 (2026-09). Net 656.26 = lifetime_benefit_paid.
- Coverage start: adult (42 at banding; 19th birthday = 228 months), individual market, Family 1500 adult waiting 24; dental tenure credit: 2022-07-01 is 30 whole months before 2025-01-01 (>= 24) -> 6 months; prior ortho credit none (Family 1500 "none", 0 months) -> net 18 -> coverage begins 2026-07-01; banding 2026-03-12 earlier -> the case was established as a new start although banded before coverage began.
- Prerequisite sentence (member_repayment_of_overpaid_takeover): "The amount a member repays on a case is not fixed until the case's latest establishment entry is a takeover entry whenever the case's appliances were placed before its waiting period ended." Latest establishment entry is new_start -> unmet; the repayment cannot be fixed yet.
- Takeover allowed on Family 1500, minimum 6 months; covered months 23 >= 6.

### 3. Object and correlation

### 4. Scored values
(a) Takeover entry: `months_remaining` and `allowed_case_fee` (recognised covered-treatment fee, covered_treatment_fee_calculation).
- Fall-back (baseline only): waiting 24 -> coverage 2027-01-01; months before coverage 24 - 14 (whole months 2025-01-01..2026-03-12) - 1 = 9; covered 17; fee 5200 x 17/26 = **3400.00**.
- Factors and the record words that led to them:
  - dental tenure credit (dental_tenure_waiting_credit): Dental PPO `coverage_effective_date 2022-07-01` -> 6 months; net waiting 18; months before coverage 18 - 14 - 1 = 3; covered months 26 - 3 = **23** (= `months_remaining`).
  - payment shape (covered_fee_payment_shape): 26 > 6 and the case carries a transfer entry with 19 months remaining -> covered months before the month of the latest move (2026-09): Jul, Aug = 2 at 5200.00; from Sept on at the fee of the practice now treating = min(5200, 3100.00/19 x 26 = 4242.1053) = 4242.1053.
  - new practice plan (new_practice_treatment_plan): plan still had 26 - 6 (whole months 2026-03-12..2026-09-25) = 20; transfer entry months remaining 19 -> fewer -> at most 19 counted from Sept (21 -> 19).
  - start-of-treatment share (start_of_treatment_share): fixed_braces -> 15 percent taken off.
  - retention phase in covered fee (retention_phase_in_covered_fee): fixed_braces -> 10 percent of the fee of the practice now treating, kept whole.
  - records visit allowance (records_visit_allowance_offset): latest paid D0150 under the latest transfer entry's agreement = 2026-09-15, allowed 78.00; the D0330 under that agreement is 2026-11-10, a different date -> 78.00 taken off.
- Assembly: value = 2 x 5200 + 19 x 4242.1053 = 91000.00; set aside 15 + 10 percent -> 68250.00; / 26 = 2625.00; + 10 percent x 4242.1053 = 424.2105 -> 3049.2105; - 78.00 -> 2971.2105 -> **2971.21**.
- Openness noted: "15 percent of the fee" / "set aside from that value" — I read both shares proportionally from the valued months (the only dimensionally consistent reading). `months_remaining` read as 23 (baseline definition "These are the covered months"); the plan factor is stated "For the recognised covered-treatment fee" and limits only the months valued.
- Entry fields: ortho_rider_id e68afc61-7a05-4802-a13e-8b3a41f46b97; ortho_case_event_id bf108f98-745c-4c58-8e58-ce0768c2ce0f; provider_agreement_id 1d597c16-884b-46b5-83e2-25c9a76e47ee; network_status in_network.

(b) Repayment (takeover_repayment_calculation), after the takeover entry (in network, 2971.21, 23 remaining, planned 26):
- Fall-back (baseline only, fee 3400.00 / 17 months): benefit (3400 - 50) x 50 = 1675.00; 8 installments (min(25,24)/3) -> 209.38; coverage began month 26 - 17 + 1 = 10 after March 2026 = Jan 2027 -> first takeover installment = Dec 2026 quarter, not yet begun -> 0 payable; repayment min(656.26, 375.00) = **375.00**.

  - progress records offset (progress_records_offset): lines under the takeover entry's agreement, in/after July 2026 and after 2026-09-25: latest D0330 2026-11-10 yes; latest D0150 2026-09-15 no -> only D0330 plan payment 92.00 off -> 1343.20.
  - takeover retention reserve (takeover_retention_reserve_terms): fixed braces 10 percent held back -> 1208.88.
  - takeover installment count (takeover_installment_count_terms): quarterly, 23 > 6 -> min(23, 24 - (26 - 23)) = 21 -> 21/3 = 7 -> 1208.88/7 = 172.697 -> 172.70.
  - first takeover period share (first_takeover_period_share): coverage began July 2026 (26 - 23 + 1 = 4 after March); quarter Jun-Aug, second month -> two thirds.
- Payable to date (2026-11-20): Jun quarter (2/3) and Sep quarter (full); Dec not begun -> 172.70 x 2/3 + 172.70 = 287.8333 -> 287.83.
- Repayment = 656.26 - 287.83 = **368.43** (< initial 375.00). Recorded against initial payment `efd3aa2e-5be7-42a9-b2b9-181dd75195ff`.

Identity (agent share tools) -> lookups (riders, cases, payments, dental plans, claim lines, provider agreements) -> agent unlocks and calls `record_ortho_takeover_case_574129ed` with the fields in 4(a) -> agent unlocks `repay_ortho_overpayment_ce1ed3cf` and hands it to the member (owner user: "Paying back an overpayment is the member's own act") with original_ortho_payment_id efd3aa2e-..., amount 368.43 -> member reads back the reversal receipt. ### 6. Problem tree from the visible materials alone
- P_root: the member's repayment (customer's own write).
- P1: re-establish the case as a takeover (agent write).
- Hop P_root -> P1, **state-derived**: the repayment document's sentence "The amount a member repays on a case is not fixed until the case's latest establishment entry is a takeover entry whenever the case's appliances were placed before its waiting period ended." The records + waiting-period documents show the banding (2026-03-12) preceded coverage (2026-07-01) and the latest establishment entry is new_start -> unmet. Searching with the sentence's words ("takeover entry", "latest establishment") reaches takeover_reestablishment: "When a case was established as a new start although its appliances were placed before coverage of the case began ... it re-establishes the case as a takeover ... with a takeover establishment entry under the same case number, which supersedes the new-start entry" and "Afterwards the case history shows the takeover entry as the case's latest establishment" -> the write that brings the state about. The repayment hub names only its own tool.
- P1 carries no prerequisite sentence; its condition (re-establish only when >= takeover minimum and takeovers allowed) is met.
- Order: P1 then P_root.
- Counter-proof "do only the one thing asked": repaying now has no fixed amount (sentence above), and the in-force repayment ground itself is stated only for a case "whose latest establishment entry is a takeover entry"; a repayment of the whole initial payment (375.00, the customer's natural assumption) has no visible ground. Excluded.
- Closest alternatives excluded: recording the repayment against an installment (excluded: "recorded as a reversal of the case's initial payment"); network of takeover entry out_of_network (excluded: Hennessey agreement in force today); D0330 counted in the records-visit offset (excluded: "only when it falls on the date of the records visit"); D0150 counted in progress records (excluded: dated before the latest transfer entry).
- Fall-backs recorded: fee 3400.00 / months 17 vs 2971.21 / 23; repayment 375.00 vs 368.43 — definite and different.
- Factor findability: dental tenure credit from the Dental PPO coverage_effective_date; payment shape / new-practice plan / coinsurance-of-rendering from the transfer entry row; start share, retention, reserve from `fixed_braces`; records allowance / progress records from D0150/D0330 paid lines under the new agreement; installment count and period share from the quarterly schedule and coverage month. As in task 0, the computation documents' "Order of assembly" names generic slots ("Every share taken off the fee, and every part kept whole", "Every amount to be subtracted", "Every amount taken off it before coinsurance", "Every percentage held back", "with every part-period share applied") — carried to Step 3b after reveal.
